<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex11052023-09-15-111356" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"> 
         <milestone unit="section" n="Carver's colophon (1b6–1b7)"/>
        <lg> <l>brkos mkhan mkhas pa <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5638">chu shul</rs> gyi ||
        </l> 
         <l>gnas pa <rs type="person" ref="db:4593" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">dpal 'phel</rs> zhes <lb n="1b7"/> bya bas ||</l> 
         <l>dad pa'i sems kyis kun blangs te ||</l> 
         <l>spar du brkos nas phul pa yi ||</l> </lg>
         <lg><l>dge bas 'gro ba ma lus pa ||</l> 
         <l>byang chub sems gnyis stobs rgyas nas ||</l> 
         <l>kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i sku thob ste ||</l> 
         <l>'gro kun srid mtsho las sgrol shog ||</l></lg></seg></TEI>
